subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinHealth evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Rivers <jrivers@finhealth.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@finhealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinHealth evaluation

Hi Janelle / Amit —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through the Redwood platform. Quick recap and a proposed POC scope so your team can review and share with procurement/IT.

What we covered
- Demo highlights: hosted API for fast integration, Dedicated option for predictable throughput and data isolation, and Redwood Console for observability and evaluation metrics.
- Showed a sample integration flow for support-ticket summarization + reranking in your claims triage pipeline.

Proposed POC objective (goal)
- Validate that Redwood can serve FinHealth’s claims summarization workload at production SLA with acceptable cost and quality. Success criteria we recommend:
  - Latency: median infer time < 250ms for 512-token median requests (95th < 700ms)
  - Quality: summary ROUGE-L improvement >= 8 points vs current baseline on 500 seed cases; business validity checks pass on 90% of samples
  - Reliability: sustained throughput of X rps during a 30-minute load window without error rate > 1%

POC plan (6 weeks)
- Week 0 (prep, 3 days): agreement, access & credentials, dataset handoff (secure S3 or signed URL).
- Week 1: sandbox setup — API keys, sample integration, access to Console dashboards.
- Week 2: ingest & baseline runs (we run baseline evaluation on your seed set).
- Week 3-4: tuning & quantization trials (we iterate on batch/quantization to meet cost/latency).
- Week 5: scale tests + reliability checks.
- Week 6: results review, ROI estimate, next-steps (pilot/production).

Owners
- FinHealth: Data/Integration owner (Amit) — provide sample dataset and test queries; Procurement for contract.
- Redwood: Marissa (sales lead), Michael Grant (pricing/dedicated options), Naomi Feldman (security & compliance lead).

Deliverables
- Shared evaluation notebook + dashboard access, weekly status notes, final POC report with metrics and recommended config.

Attachments
- redwood-poc-outline.pdf (POC scope & success criteria)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high-level milestones and owners)

Ask / next steps
- Can you confirm the technical contact for dataset handoff?
- Is procurement looped in or should we include them in the next email?
- If this looks good, proposed kickoff: Tue, 17 Nov 2026.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15-min sync to align.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

---
(Attachment stubs: redwood-poc-outline.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx)

From: Janelle Rivers <jrivers@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@finhealth.com>
Cc: FinHealth Procurement <procurement@finhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 18:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinHealth evaluation

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap and appreciate the clear milestones. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: the latency targets look reasonable. For quality we need the final report to include a short set of human-review cases (20) flagged by business SMEs to validate semantic correctness — can we add that to the deliverables?
- Data privacy: we require that all test data remains in our account or is stored encrypted at rest and access logged. Naomi or your security lead will need to provide the SOC2 summary and explanation of retention policy.
- Procurement: looping them here. We’ll need a ballpark for Dedicated pricing (monthly) vs Hosted (usage) to evaluate. Any chance Michael can share a quick estimate?

Tentative kickoff: Tue, 17 Nov works for Amit and me but procurement may need a week to review terms. Please confirm if the 17th is just a technical kickoff (no contract required) or if you need signed MSA first.

Appreciate it —
Janelle Rivers
Director, Data Platforms | FinHealth
jrivers@finhealth.com | +1 212-555-0147

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Rivers <jrivers@finhealth.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@finhealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinHealth evaluation

Hi Janelle — great points. Short answers:

- Yes, we’ll include a 20-case human review set in the final deliverables.
- Naomi — can you share the SOC2 summary and a short note on retention/access controls?
- Michael — can you provide a hosted vs dedicated ballpark (monthly and expected first-month TCO) and attach a pricing stub?

On kickoff: the 17th can be a technical kickoff (API access, dataset handoff) while procurement continues contracting in parallel. We typically run sandbox access under an NDA or limited-time eval agreement — not full MSA. If procurement needs a PO or signed agreement to enable Dedicated capacity, we can accommodate timelines but that won’t block the sandbox kickoff.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Michael to send high-level pricing estimate (cc’d).
- Naomi to share SOC2 summary + retention note.
- Janelle/Amit to confirm dataset contact and tentative kickoff on 17 Nov.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Rivers <jrivers@finhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@finhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinHealth evaluation

Janelle — quick pricing note and next steps. Attached is a ballpark for Dedicated vs Hosted for the proposed POC footprint. Numbers are estimates and will be finalized after we see the seed dataset and expected QPS.

- Hosted (usage): approx $2,500–$4,000 for the 6-week evaluation (usage-based, depends on tokens/embedding units).
- Dedicated (reserved mini-pool): approx $9,000–$15,000 (one-month equivalent reserve to ensure predictable throughput); includes priority routing and data isolation.

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf

If that looks in range, we can draft a short Eval Agreement and provision sandbox access immediately.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0122
